label: Full Charge v4
info:
# 🔋 Full Charge Control (Victron / DVCC) — v4

Controls the DVCC charge voltage of a Victron battery system with JK-BMS.

## Basic Rule
Whenever **Free** is active (DVCC = 0 V, BMS controls), full-charge detection runs –
regardless of mode. Every CVL drop ≥ DELTA_V after a peak counts as a
full charge and creates a history entry.

## Modes (select "Charge Control" on GX / in VRM)
| Selection | DVCC |
|---|---|
| **Auto Charge** | Logic decides |
| **Manual Conservation** | Conservation voltage |
| **Manual Free** | 0 V, BMS controls |

### Auto
- **Conservation charge**, until the set interval (calendar weeks) has elapsed
  since the last full charge (no history: due immediately)
- then **Free**, until the BMS confirms full charge via CVL drop –
  no time limit, may last weeks in winter
- after detected full charge: history entry, interval restarts,
  back to conservation charge
- the actual charge state is shown in the "Charge" indicator

### Manual
- Conservation or Free, permanently as selected, logic never switches on its own
- in Free mode every full charge is detected, written as `manual` to history
  and resets the auto interval

### Mode Change
- History is preserved, detection continues
- when switching to Auto, the last history entry counts,
  regardless of whether it came from Auto or Manual

## Display on GX (gui-v2 / VRM Switch-Pane, group "Full Charge Control")
- Select **Charge Control** (Auto Charge / Manual Conservation / Manual Free)
- **Charge**: Current Conservation / Free (from the actually written DVCC)
- **Conservation Voltage** and **Full Charge Interval (Weeks)**: input with − / +
- **Last Full Charge**: left shows date and time of the last history entry,
  right shows days since then (value field can only be numeric)
- every detected full charge → Info event in VRM Event Log

## History Entry
`{ kw, year, date, time, quelle: "auto" | "manual" }`
Legacy entries without `time` are shown with date only.
Legacy entries with `forced: true` originate from the removed failsafe.

## Parameters
Changeable on GX / Local UI only, not from VRM (group "Full Charge Control"), persisted across restarts:
- **Conservation Voltage**: 52.0–54.4 V, step 0.1 V (default 53.9 V)
- **Full Charge Interval (Weeks)**: 1–8 calendar weeks (default 2)

In VRM both values appear read-only ("Set to"), fed from the actually active values of the logic.

Changes take effect immediately. A shortened interval can trigger Free immediately;
a lengthened interval during an ongoing full charge aborts it
and switches to conservation charge. Limits and fallback values are also defined
in the logic node (values outside the range are ignored).

Fixed in logic node:
- `DELTA_V` = 0.5 V — CVL drop detection

## Paths
- History: `/data/home/nodered/.node-red/history/volladung_history.json`
- DVCC:    `com.victronenergy.settings → /Settings/SystemSetup/MaxChargeVoltage`
- CVL:     `com.victronenergy.battery/512 → /Info/MaxChargeVoltage`
